items.source_en:
Managed to bribe a transport pilot who got some footage of Victor Compound.
Pilot counted a whole mess of Syndicate goons (at least 10+). 
He sold me his ID badge for 1000 credits. Wouldn't sign for it, so the Rangers will just have to take my word.
